scenario: [LUNI.4.5.2]: at a `where` comparison between two dimensions one `implicit` formula bridges ([LUNI.4.5.1] boundary 2), the LEFT operand converts into the right's dimension, and for an `inverting` formula the operator flips. `a.freq > b.p` with `a.freq` = 4 Hz is `hz_to_tick(4) < b.p`, that is 0.25 < b.p. Against `b1` (p = 0.5) that holds and against `b2` (p = 0.1) it does not, so only `b1` matches. Unconverted (4 > p) both would match; converted without the flip (0.25 > p) only `b2` would. PATH PINNED: `luni_4_5_2_step` in dsc.rete, called from `rlow_6_2_1_chain`, which lowers the left operand through `lgra_9_8_11_formula_call` and flips the operator with `luni_4_5_2_flip`.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency
unit dimension period storage float64 base tick
unit tick: period

unit formula hz_tick inverting implicit:
    hz_to_tick(x: Hz): tick  = 1.0 / x
    tick_to_hz(x: tick): Hz  = 1.0 / x

schema A scope logical:
    id: String key
    freq: Hz mutable

schema B scope logical:
    id: String key
    p: tick mutable

rule cmp:
    A a
    B b where a.freq > b.p
->
    log info "match {b.id}"
